title: Integrating Biomimetic Design and Virtual Reality Technology in Commercial Exhibition Space Design: A Biotechnological Approach

findings.mechanism: The integration of biomimetic design and VR technology in exhibition spaces leads to a certain level of perceived environmental adaptability.
findings.quote: the environmental adaptability of the bionic virtual design scores an average of 1.63

findings.mechanism: The integration of biomimetic design and VR technology in exhibition spaces leads to a certain level of perceived environmental authenticity.
findings.quote: the environmental authenticity scores an average of 0.75

findings.antecedent: integrating biomimetic design with virtual reality technology in commercial exhibition spaces
findings.consequent: positive evaluations of the overall environment
findings.mechanism: The combination of biomimetic principles and VR creates dynamic and engaging spaces, leading to a high percentage of positive participant evaluations.
findings.quote: 85.5% of participants provide positive evaluations of the overall environment.

stimuli.description: commercial exhibition spaces designed using cell-like biomimetic methods, emotional biomimetic design, and integrated with virtual reality technology
